title: Influence and positive-output pivotal probability
statement: Let $p\in(0,1)$, let $f$ be a monotone function from the $n$-dimensional sign cube to the two signs, and let $i$ be a coordinate. Under the product distribution with bias parameter $p$, the influence of the real-valued sign representation of $f$ at $i$ equals $4p$ times the probability that $f$ outputs $+1$ and changing coordinate $i$ changes its output.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ maps the sign cube to the two signs
